row.scim_price_text: Not offered (SSO JIT and custom mapping on Enterprise only)
row.team_price_text: Team: starting at $25/mo billed monthly (up to 10 developers)
row.evidence: Snyk's docs say SSO is available only for Enterprise plans and that users are provisioned with a new Snyk account when they first sign on through SSO; no SCIM endpoint appears in the docs index or the REST API specification.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to none: the June row counted Enterprise SSO custom mapping as SCIM-like, but the Sept 2026 rules classify a vendor with no SCIM endpoint whose only automation is JIT on SSO sign-in as none (fallbacks.jit true). No SCIM appears in docs.snyk.io/llms.txt or the REST OpenAPI spec; Snyk's IdP setup guides all use custom/non-gallery SAML apps. Pricing changed shape: Free $0, Team 'Starting at $25 / month billed monthly' for up to 10 developers, and Enterprise is now a credit-based Platform Subscription (1 credit = $1, Contact Sales). June's '$25/contributing dev/mo' per-developer basis and the '$5K-70K+/yr' Enterprise range are not stated on Snyk's pages, so they are dropped; per-user fields are null. The Snyk API (user management, audit logs) is Enterprise only.

plans.name: Team
plans.price_text: Starting at $25 / month, billed monthly; up to 10 developers
plans.notes: Page does not say whether $25 is per developer.

plans.name: Enterprise (Snyk Platform Subscription)
plans.price_text: Contact Sales for pricing; prepaid credits, 1 credit = $1
plans.notes: scim false: no SCIM endpoint documented at any tier (absence, not an explicit statement).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint found in docs.snyk.io (llms.txt index has no SCIM page) or the REST OpenAPI spec; this is absence, not an explicit 'no'.

roles.how: Not SCIM: Enterprise custom mapping reads a 'roles' string array from the SAML/OIDC assertion (format snyk:{scope}:{target}:{role}) to assign Tenant, Group and Organization roles at sign-in.

capabilities.notes: create_user means pre-provisioning an SSO user to an Organization before first login (POST /v1/org/{orgId}/provision); 'Groups' here are Snyk Groups (account hierarchy), not user groups.

endpoints.purpose: Remove a member from an Organization
List all members in a Group
Provision an SSO user to an Organization with a role before first login
Delete a user from a Group SSO connection (full delete)
Get all memberships of the group
Create a group membership for a user with role
Update a role from a group membership
Delete a membership from a group
Get all memberships of the org
Create an org membership for a user with role

rate_limits.text: 1620 requests per minute per API key (REST API).

limitations.text: Removing a member from a Group leaves the user in Snyk; full deletion needs the Group SSO connection delete call and only works when the SSO connection is tied to one Group.

okta.notes: Snyk's Okta guide creates a custom app integration; okta.com/integrations/snyk/ returned 404.

entra.notes: Snyk's Entra guide uses a Non-gallery application; Microsoft's snyk-tutorial URL returned 404.

google.notes: Snyk's guide uses a custom SAML app.

onelogin.notes: Snyk's guide uses OneLogin's SAML Custom Connector (Advanced).

jumpcloud.notes: SAML SSO connector only; Snyk is not in JumpCloud's SCIM connector list.

fallbacks.other_sync: Enterprise SSO custom mapping assigns Groups/Organizations/roles from IdP assertions at sign-in; REST/V1 provisioning endpoints can pre-provision SSO users.
